root_cause: The bilingual SEO implementation added and recomposed visible Dutch strings after the last complete English cache snapshot. Production and deploy previews require a complete committed cache, so the localized build correctly failed closed on 23 missing exact source strings.
prevention: Every visible source-string change on localized public routes must update the committed English translation cache in the same candidate.
Validate the exact final source strings with build-localized-routes --validate-cache before protected merge.
Never bypass STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE or allow Dutch fallback on English production pages.
fix: Add the 23 exact missing Modelwijzer, governance, CTA, footer and Company Brain strings to the canonical English cache patch and preserve the fail-closed production gate.
